name: Beijing DeepZero Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing DeepZero Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a provider of AI-powered marketing and sales decision-making solutions in China. It offers products, such as the AlphaData intelligent user data operation platform, an AI intelligent customer data platform (CDP), an intelligent automated marketing platform (MA), and the AlphaDesk intelligent marketing and delivery platform; and services for industries including smart fast-moving consumer goods, smart retail, smart beauty, and smart automotive. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
